svg.title: KHATIM — The Witnessed Letter (cross-glyph K ∩ خ)
svg.desc: EXPLORATION. One bold angular glyph reading as both Latin K and Arabic kha (خ): a weighty stem with two 45-degree arms, crowned by a single positional nuqta at the I'jam register. The dot decides the letter — present it is witnessed kha and the mark is sealed; absent it is an unwitnessed letter. Development candidate — NOT final.
